plot: At Sunday lunch Mia brings home a lamppost poster of a lost grey kitten called Smoke with Button's bent ear, and Mom will call the number after lunch; Bup's one try to hide the poster ends with him splashing into Grandma's French-toast egg bowl and nearly getting fried, the number is already on the fridge whiteboard, and then — the twist — Lolly drying the eggy poster finds its date, April third (it looked sun-faded at the start and the vet said Button is six weeks old), so Smoke is a grown cat: not Button but Button's mother; Mrs. Hale lets Button stay, then says she is bringing Smoke tomorrow — a cat who steals bread from every kitchen.

script.title: Someone Is Looking for Our Kitten

beats.say: Lost kitten? No, no, no! Button is not lost. She's ours!
Pim, breathe. It's a poster. Mia tore it off the lamppost.
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
Sunday noon at the kitchen table. Grandma is making French toast.
In the bread basket, Button the kitten is just waking up.
Mia stands by the table, the poster shaking in her hands.
Mom reads it twice. Then she says: we call after lunch.
After lunch? That's one hour! I found her! I pulled her out!
You did, little bean. You were brave under that porch.
Facts. Lost grey kitten. Answers to Smoke. Phone number at the bottom.
Then we test it. Button or Smoke. Which name does she answer?
Bup cups his crusty hands. Smoke! Button doesn't even blink.
He tries again. Button! She yawns and licks her paw.
She's a baby, Bup. She answers to tuna. That's it.
This paper is so faded, though. Like icing left in the sun.
Irrelevant. Also, the vet said Button is only six weeks old.
The kitten in the photo has one bent ear. Just like Button.
It's her. It's really her. Someone is going to take her away.
One phone call after lunch, and Button could be gone forever.
Not if there's no poster. No poster, no number, no call.
Bup grabs the poster and sprints across the table.
Bup, stop! That poster belongs to a little girl!
Bup doesn't stop. He doesn't see Grandma's big bowl of eggs.
Bup pops up dripping yellow. Egg, milk, and a pinch of sugar.
Why is it warm in here? Why do I smell like breakfast?
Grandma turns around with her frying pan. She sees a perfect slice.
Bup. You are stale bread soaked in egg. You are French toast.
Grandma's fork comes down. Lolly yanks Bup out by his crust.
The fork hits an empty bowl. Grandma blinks. Then she shrugs.
Never. Ever. Steal. Again. Do you hear me?
Yes, ma'am. Sorry, ma'am. I smell delicious, ma'am.
The poster is soaked too. The phone number is one yellow blur.
The number's gone? Then nobody can call! She stays!
But Mom already copied the number onto the fridge whiteboard.
Ten minutes of lunch left. Then Mom calls. Then it's over.
I pulled you out for a home. Now you'll lose it.
Lolly peels the wet poster off the table to dry it.
Under the egg, the top corner shows a tiny date. April third.
April. Pim, this poster has been out there since April.
April to November. Seven months. My calculations say...
Smoke is a grown cat by now. Button is six weeks.
Same grey fur. Same bent ear. Seven months apart.
Smoke isn't Button. Smoke is Button's mother.
Her mom? Button has a mom? And her mom got lost too?
Lunch ends. Mom dials the number from the whiteboard.
An old lady answers. Mrs. Hale, from two streets over.
Smoke came home in summer. Then she had kittens.
One grey girl with a bent ear wandered off in the storm.
Mrs. Hale laughs. If she picked your family, then she's yours.
She stays! And she has a mom! Everybody has somebody!
Great. Can somebody help me? The egg is drying. I'm crunchy.
Then Mrs. Hale says one more thing. She's bringing Smoke tomorrow.
To meet her baby. And Smoke steals bread from every kitchen.
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

Mia finds a lost-kitten poster that looks just like Button, Mom will call the number after lunch, and Bup's plan to hide it ends in Grandma's egg bowl.

es.description:
¿Qué crees que pasará en la próxima parte? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
"La saqué de debajo de ese porche. ¿Y ahora alguien la quiere de vuelta?" — Pim
Mia encuentra un cartel de gatita perdida igual a Button, mamá llamará después del almuerzo, y el plan de Bup para esconderlo termina en el bol de huevos de la abuela.
#serie #Animación3D #DoughBros

A Mia acha um cartaz de gatinha perdida igualzinha à Button, a mãe vai ligar depois do almoço, e o plano do Bup de esconder o cartaz termina na tigela de ovos da vovó.
#série #Animação3D #DoughBros

ar.description:
ماذا تظن أنه سيحدث في الجزء القادم؟ أخبرني في التعليقات.
"أنا أخرجتها من تحت تلك الشرفة. والآن شخص ما يريد استعادتها؟" — بيم
تجد ميا ملصقًا لقطة مفقودة تشبه بوتون تمامًا، وستتصل أمها بعد الغداء، وخطة باب لإخفائه تنتهي في وعاء بيض الجدة.
#مسلسل #رسوم_ثلاثية_الأبعاد #DoughBros

fr.title: Quelqu'un cherche notre chatonne 😿
fr.description:
Selon toi, que se passe-t-il dans la prochaine partie ? Dis-le-moi en commentaire.
"Je l'ai sortie de sous ce porche. Et maintenant quelqu'un veut la récupérer ?" — Pim
Mia trouve une affiche de chatonne perdue qui ressemble à Button, Maman appellera après le déjeuner, et le plan de Bup pour la cacher finit dans le bol d'œufs de Mamie.
#série #Animation3D #DoughBros

ja.title: 誰かがぼくらの子猫をさがしてる 😿
ja.description:
次はどうなると思う？コメントで教えてね。
「ポーチの下からぼくが助けたのに。今さら返してって？」— ピム
ミアが見つけた迷子猫のポスターはボタンにそっくり。ママは昼ごはんのあとに電話するつもり。ポスターを隠そうとしたバップは、おばあちゃんの卵のボウルに落ちてしまう。
#シリーズ #3Dアニメ #DoughBros

ko.title: 누군가 우리 새끼 고양이를 찾고 있어 😿
ko.description:
다음 편에서 무슨 일이 일어날까요? 댓글로 알려주세요.
"내가 현관 밑에서 꺼내 줬는데. 이제 누가 돌려달래?" — 핌
미아가 버튼과 똑같이 생긴 잃어버린 고양이 포스터를 찾아오고, 엄마는 점심 후에 전화하기로 해요. 포스터를 숨기려던 법의 계획은 할머니의 달걀 그릇에서 끝나요.
#시리즈 #3D애니메이션 #DoughBros
